configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.displayName: windows-x64: the Windows product (MSVC x64, SDL3): the client
configurePresets.description: Needs MSVC for x64 set up (vcvarsall.bat x64): python -I tools/build.py windows-x64 does it. Needs Tibia.exe in the root (or PATELLA_TIBIA_EXE) for the client's resources, and Python; PATELLA_CLIENT=OFF builds only the portable libraries; without Tibia.exe PATELLA_PLACEHOLDER_RESOURCES=ON builds the client with neutral pictures (the hosted CI's build).

configurePresets.name: linux-x64-gcc
configurePresets.displayName: linux-x64-gcc: GCC 16 on Linux x64: the Linux client (Patella; issue #131)
configurePresets.description: Needs GCC 16 (gcc, g++) on PATH and SDL3's X11/Wayland build dependencies; the Docker image of docker/linux-x64 has them. On Windows: python -I tools/build.py linux-x64-gcc runs it in that image, with the local Tibia.exe's cursors (mounted read-only). PATELLA_CLIENT=OFF: only the portable libraries; PATELLA_PLACEHOLDER_RESOURCES=ON: neutral pictures, the hosted CI's build.

configurePresets.name: package-windows-x64
configurePresets.displayName: package-windows-x64: the Windows zip (issue #135, cmake/Package.cmake): the client with the placeholder pictures
configurePresets.description: A folder without Tibia.exe: the placeholders are refused where a Tibia.exe exists, and PATELLA_PACKAGE is refused without them.

configurePresets.name: package-linux-x64

configurePresets.description: A folder without Tibia.exe, in the image of docker/linux-x64: the placeholders are refused where a Tibia.exe exists, and PATELLA_PACKAGE is refused without them.
